scenarios.instructions: Open arena: Sven starts distant at (2,7), two ordinary sheep at (13,5)/(13,9), both initially at max anger 10. Stay away without interacting and watch long enough: impatience rises toward 12 after 41 pulses of 26/60 seconds, then a 1-in-5 chance triggers transformation. Repeated attempts can take more than a minute; record elapsed time and repeat if needed. Approach during transformation to observe acquisition, pursuit, contact/attack, recovery and collision in open cells. Do not resolve both sheep. One sheep randomly receives Frigida flag 1 at load; only interaction converts that flag to 2, which prevents the demon trigger. Avoid early interaction so the normal trigger remains available. No demon state is prebaked; UFO graphics remain visible and timeout collection can still occur.
